author: Marshall & Iwamoto, 1973

note.en: A small glass-headed grenadier of the slope; only a regional record.
note.es: Un granadero pequeño de cabeza transparente de la pendiente; solo un registro regional.

evidence: FishBase lists it for Costa Rica and the Western Central Atlantic, with no local sighting reports found
recWhy: Deep-slope fish with only a FishBase listing for Costa Rica.
